cards.en:
Think of a box inside a box. A control structure (an if, a for, a while) is a box of statements. You can put one box inside another.

Rule:

  • Any structure can hold any other: if in if, loop in loop, if in loop, loop in an if branch.
  • In Python, indentation (the spaces at the start of a line) shows which box a line belongs to. One more level of spaces = one box deeper.
  • Read nested code from the outside in: does the outer structure enter its body? Only then look at the inner one.

Exam wording: Placing a structure into another structure is called a nested structure.
cards.zh:
想像盒子里放盒子。控制结构（if、for、while）就是一个装语句的盒子，盒子可以放进另一个盒子。

规则：

  • 任何结构都能包含任何结构：if 套 if、循环套循环、循环里有 if、if 分支里有循环。
  • Python 用 indentation（缩进）表示属于哪个盒子：多一层空格 = 深一层。
  • 读嵌套代码要由外到内：先看外层会不会进入 body，再看内层。

考试写法：Placing a structure into another structure is called a nested structure.

ex.q:
Which lines are inside the inner loop?
for i in range(3):
    print('row', i)
    for j in range(2):
        print(i, j)
print('end')
ex.a:
1. Count spaces. print(i, j) has 8 spaces: inner loop body.
  2. print('row', i) and for j have 4: outer loop body.
  3. print('end') has 0: outside, runs once.
ex.az:
1. 数空格：print(i, j) 8 格 → 内循环。
  2. print('row', i) 和 for j 4 格 → 外循环。
  3. print('end') 0 格 → 循环外，只执行一次。

ex.q: Name the nesting in: for x in data: / if x > 0: / count = count + 1
ex.a:
1. Outer: a for loop (iteration).
  2. Inside it: an if (selection).
  3. So it is selection nested in iteration: the if is tested once per item.
ex.az:
1. 外层 for（迭代）。
  2. 里面 if（选择）。
  3. 即“循环里嵌套 if”，每个元素测试一次。

ex.q:
A student wants print('done') to run once after the loop, but wrote:
for i in range(3):
    total = total + i
    print('done')
What goes wrong?
ex.a:
1. print('done') has 4 spaces, so it is inside the loop.
  2. It prints 3 times, not once.
  3. Fix: remove the indentation so it lines up with for.
ex.az:
1. print('done') 缩进了 4 格 → 在循环里面。
  2. 会印 3 次。
  3. 改正：去掉缩进，与 for 对齐。

notes.t: In outer body: runs once per i.
notes.tz: 外循环体：每个 i 执行一次。

notes.t: Inner loop inside the outer body: j takes 0, 1.
notes.tz: 内循环在外循环体里：j 取 0、1。
内循环体：共执行 2×2=4 次。

notes.t: No indent: outside both loops, runs once.
notes.tz: 没缩进：在循环外，只执行一次。

cards.en:
Some questions only make sense after another question. A shop asks "Are you a member?" and only if yes asks "Gold or silver?". That is a nested if.

Rule:

  • The inner if is tested only when the outer condition leads into its branch.
  • elif is shorthand for an if inside the else of the previous if.
  • Conditions are tested top to bottom; only the first True branch runs.

Exam wording: A nested conditional statement decides whether to enter another conditional statement based on the result of the previous condition.
cards.zh:
有些问题要先答了第一个才有意义：商店先问“你是会员吗？”，是才问“金卡还是银卡？”。这就是嵌套 if。

规则：

  • 外层条件把程序带进那个分支，内层 if 才会被测试。
  • elif 等于在上一个 if 的 else 里再放一个 if。
  • 由上到下测试，只执行第一个 True 的分支。

考试写法：A nested conditional statement decides whether to enter another conditional statement based on the result of the previous condition.

ex.a:
1. Keep the first if.
  2. Turn elif into else: + an indented if.
if m >= 80:
    g = 'A'
else:
    if m >= 50:
        g = 'B'
    else:
        g = 'F'
Same flowchart.
ex.az:
1. 保留第一个 if。
  2. elif 改成 else: 加缩进的 if。
流程图相同。

ex.q: m = 65 in the code above. Which conditions are tested? Value of g?
ex.a:
1. m >= 80? 65 → False, go to else.
  2. m >= 50? True → g = 'B'.
  3. Two conditions tested; g = 'B'.
ex.az:
1. 65≥80？否，进 else。
  2. 65≥50？是，g='B'。
  3. 共测两个条件。

ex.a:
1. Separate ifs are all tested; they are not nested.
  2. Reversed: m>=80 → g='A', then m>=50 also True → g='B'.
  3. Wrong answer 'B'. Fix: use if-elif-else (or nesting) so only one branch runs.
ex.az:
1. 独立的 if 全部都会测试，不是嵌套。
  2. 次序颠倒后：先 g='A'，再被 m≥50 改成 'B'。
  3. 改正：用 if-elif-else，只执行一个分支。

notes.t: Read the mark as an integer.
Inner test, only reached when m < 80.
notes.tz: 内层条件，只在 m<80 时测试。

cards.en:
Nesting is not only for the else part. A question can follow either answer: "Is it raining? Yes → do you have an umbrella? No → is it hot?"

Rule:

  • An if can be nested in the True branch, the False branch, or both.
  • In if c1: (if c2) else: (if c3), c1 True → only c2 tested; c1 False → only c3 tested.
  • In a flowchart, each diamond has a True exit and a False exit; the inner diamond hangs off one exit.
  • No else = that path does nothing.

Exam wording: A conditional statement can be nested in any branch of another conditional statement.
cards.zh:
嵌套不只放在 else。任何一个答案后面都可以再问：“下雨吗？是 → 有伞吗？否 → 热吗？”

规则：

  • if 可以放在 True 分支、False 分支或两边都放。
  • if c1: (if c2) else: (if c3)：c1 True 只测 c2；False 只测 c3。
  • Flowchart 里每个菱形有 True / False 两个出口，内层菱形接在其中一个出口。
  • 没有 else，那条路径什么都不做。

考试写法：A conditional statement can be nested in any branch of another conditional statement.

ex.a:
1. 7 > 5 True → enter the first branch.
  2. 7 % 2 = 1, so == 0 is False → else.
  3. Output big odd. x < 0 is never tested.
ex.az:
1. 7>5 成立，进第一个分支。
  2. 7%2=1，不等于 0 → else。
  3. 输出 big odd；x<0 没测。

ex.q: Same code, x = 3. Output?
ex.a:
1. 3 > 5 False → outer else.
  2. 3 < 0 False, and there is no inner else.
  3. Nothing is printed.
ex.az:
1. 3>5 不成立 → 外层 else。
  2. 3<0 不成立，又没有内层 else。
  3. 什么都不输出。

ex.q: A student claims: "For x = 7, the program tests x > 5, x % 2 == 0 and x < 0." Correct them.
ex.a:
1. x < 0 sits in the outer else branch.
  2. That branch is skipped because x > 5 is True.
  3. Only 2 conditions are tested. Count only conditions on the path actually taken.
ex.az:
1. x<0 在外层 else 分支。
  2. x>5 为 True，这分支被跳过。
  3. 只测 2 个条件；只数实际走过的路径。

notes.t: Inner test in the True branch.
notes.tz: True 分支里的内层条件。

notes.t: Inner test in the False branch.
notes.tz: False 分支里的内层条件。

cards.en:
A guard at a door checks your ticket first, then your seat. Checking the seat of someone with no ticket is pointless. In a multi-level decision order matters.

Rule for sides a, b, c:

  1. Reject invalid input: any side <= 0.
  2. Reject impossible triangles: the sum of any two sides must be greater than the third.
  3. Then classify: equilateral (all equal) → else isosceles (two equal) → else scalene.

Equilateral must come before isosceles, because an equilateral triangle also passes the isosceles test.

Exam wording: Test the more specific condition first; the sum of any two sides must be greater than the third side.
cards.zh:
门口保安先查票，再看座位；没票的人看座位没意义。多层判断次序很重要。

三边 a, b, c 的规则：

  1. 先排除无效输入：任一边 ≤0。
  2. 再排除不能成形：任意两边之和必须大于第三边。
  3. 再分类：equilateral 等边 → 否则 isosceles 等腰 → 否则 scalene 不等边。

等边要先测，因为等边三角形也满足等腰条件。

考试写法：Test the more specific condition first; the sum of any two sides must be greater than the third side.

ex.q: Classify (2, 2, 5).
ex.a:
1. All sides > 0, pass.
  2. 2 + 2 = 4 <= 5 → cannot form.
  3. Output Cannot form a triangle.
ex.az:
1. 三边都 >0。
  2. 2+2=4≤5 → 不能成形。

ex.q: Classify (5, 5, 8).
ex.a:
1. Valid and 5+5=10 > 8, 5+8 > 5: can form.
  2. Not all equal.
  3. a == b → isosceles.
ex.az:
1. 有效且能成形。
  2. 不全等。
  3. a==b → 等腰。

ex.q: A student tests isosceles before equilateral. What does (3, 3, 3) give?
ex.a:
1. a == b is True, so the isosceles branch runs first.
  2. Output isosceles – wrong.
  3. Fix: test the stricter condition (equilateral) first.
ex.az:
1. a==b 已成立，先进了等腰分支。
  2. 输出 isosceles，错。
  3. 改正：先测较严格的等边。

notes.tz: 定义函数，三个参数是三边。

notes.t: Sum of two sides not greater than the third?
notes.tz: 两边之和不大于第三边？

notes.t: Most specific test first: all equal.
notes.tz: 最严格的先测：三边相等。

code.out:
equilateral
Cannot form a triangle
scalene
isosceles

cards.en:
A dancing robot repeats a whole routine 10 times. Inside the routine it does "repeat 10 times: sit-up". A loop inside a loop.

Rule:

  • The loop outside is the outer loop; the one inside is the inner loop.
  • Each time the outer loop body runs once, the inner loop runs completely.
  • The inner counter starts again from its first value at every outer repetition.
  • Use nested loops for rows × columns: patterns, tables, 2D arrays.

Exam wording: Placing a loop into another loop is called a nested loop. Each time the outer loop body is executed once, the inner loop is executed completely.
cards.zh:
跳舞机器人把整套动作重复 10 次，动作里有“重复 10 次仰卧起坐”。这就是循环里的循环。

规则：

  • 外面是 outer loop，里面是 inner loop。
  • 外循环体执行一次，内循环就完整跑完一轮。
  • 每次外层重复，内层计数器重新开始。
  • 适合“行×列”：图案、表格、二维数组。

考试写法：Placing a loop into another loop is called a nested loop. Each time the outer loop body is executed once, the inner loop is executed completely.

ex.q: Robot: repeat 10 times { repeat 10 times: sit-up }. Most sit-ups in a row? Total?
ex.a:
1. One run of the inner loop = 10 in a row.
  2. Inner loop runs once per outer repetition: 10 times.
  3. Total = 10 × 10 = 100.
ex.az:
1. 内循环一轮连续 10 个。
  2. 外层 10 次。
  3. 共 100 个。

1. i=0 时 j=0,1,2。
  2. i=1 时 j 重新从 0 开始。
  3. 共 6 行。

ex.q: A student thinks the output above is 0 0, 1 1 (both counters move together). Explain.
ex.a:
1. The counters do not move together.
  2. i stays fixed while j runs through all its values.
  3. Only after the inner loop finishes does i go up. Correct output has 2 × 3 = 6 lines.
ex.az:
1. 两个计数器不会一起动。
  2. j 跑完全部值时 i 不变。
  3. 内循环结束 i 才加一，共 6 行。

notes.t: Inner loop restarts for each i: j = 0, 1, 2.
notes.tz: 内循环每个 i 都重新开始：j=0,1,2。

cards.t: Execution flow of a nested for loop
cards.tz: 嵌套 for 循环的执行流程
cards.en:
Like reading a book: for each page (outer), read every line (inner). You never jump to the next page in the middle of a line.

Flow:

  1. Set i to its first value; test i (False → leave).
  2. Set j to its first value; test j (False → go to i + 1).
  3. Run inner body; j + 1; back to test j.
  4. Inner loop done → i + 1 → back to test i.

Pseudocode vs Python: for i from 1 to 3 includes 3 → range(1, 4). for j from 3 down to 1 → range(3, 0, -1). range stops before its second number; the third number is the step.

Exam wording: The inner loop counter is re-initialised each time the outer loop body is executed.
cards.zh:
像看书：每一页（外层）读完所有行（内层），不会读到一半跳去下一页。

流程：

  1. i 设初值，测 i（False 离开）。
  2. j 设初值，测 j（False 去 i+1）。
  3. 执行内循环体；j+1；回到测 j。
  4. 内循环完 → i+1 → 回到测 i。

伪代码 vs Python：for i from 1 to 3 包括 3 → range(1, 4)；from 3 down to 1 → range(3, 0, -1)。range 不包括第二个数，第三个数是 step。

考试写法：The inner loop counter is re-initialised each time the outer loop body is executed.

ex.q: Convert to Python and give the output: for i from 1 to 3 / for j from 3 down to 1 / output i + j.
ex.a:
1. i: range(1, 4). j: range(3, 0, -1).
  2. i=1: 4 3 2. i=2: 5 4 3. i=3: 6 5 4.
  3. Output 4 3 2 5 4 3 6 5 4 (one per line).

ex.q: Pseudocode: for i from 0 to 1 / for j from 0 to 2. How many times does the inner body run?
ex.a:
1. i has 2 values (0, 1).
  2. j has 3 values (0, 1, 2).
  3. 2 × 3 = 6.
ex.az:
1. i 有 2 个值，j 有 3 个值。
  2. 2×3=6。

ex.q: A student converts for j from 3 down to 1 to range(3, 1, -1). What is wrong?
ex.a:
1. range stops before the end value.
  2. range(3, 1, -1) gives 3, 2 only – 1 is missing.
  3. Correct: range(3, 0, -1).
ex.az:
1. range 不包括终值。
  2. range(3,1,-1) 只有 3、2。
  3. 正确：range(3, 0, -1)。

cards.tz: 用 trace table 追踪嵌套循环
cards.en:
A trace table (dry run) is like a diary of the program: one row each time something changes. It stops you guessing.

How:

  • One column per variable, plus Output.
  • Add a row each time a counter changes or something is printed.
  • Only fill the cell that changes.
ijOutput
00
00
11
22
11
0,1,20 1 2

Exam wording: Each time the outer loop body is executed, the inner loop body is executed three times.
cards.zh:
Trace table（dry run 干运行）像程序的日记：每次有变化就记一行，避免靠猜。

做法：

  • 每个变量一栏，再加 Output 栏。
  • 计数器变或有输出就加一行。
  • 只填改变的格。

考试写法：Each time the outer loop body is executed, the inner loop body is executed three times.

ex.q:
Full output of
for i in range(0, 2):
    print(i)
    for j in range(0, 3):
        print(j)
ex.a:
1. i=0: print 0, then j: 0 1 2.
  2. i=1: print 1, then j: 0 1 2.
  3. Output: 0 0 1 2 1 0 1 2 (8 lines).

ex.q: A student's table for the first code shows j = 3 after the inner loop and then i = 1 with j still 3. Why is this misleading?
ex.a:
1. range(0, 3) never gives j = 3; the last value is 2.
  2. When i becomes 1, j is reset to 0 by the inner for.
  3. Write the real values: j goes 0, 1, 2 again.
ex.az:
1. range(0,3) 不会给 j=3，最后是 2。
  2. i 变 1 时 j 由内层 for 重设为 0。

notes.t: Accumulator starts at 0, before both loops.
notes.tz: 累加器在两层循环之前设 0。

cards.en:
A school has 5 classes, each with 10 students. Shaking every hand takes 5 × 10 = 50 handshakes. Nested loops count the same way.

Rule:

  • Fixed inner range: total inner runs = outer runs × inner runs.
  • Three levels: multiply all three.
  • Inner range depends on i (e.g. range(1, i+1)): add each pass: 1 + 2 + … + n = n(n+1)/2.
  • "from 1 to 5" has 5 values; range(1, 5) has 4.

Exam wording: Number of times the inner loop body is executed = number of repetitions of the outer loop × number of repetitions of the inner loop.
cards.zh:
学校 5 班，每班 10 人，握手 5×10=50 次。嵌套循环也这样数。

规则：

  • 内层范围固定：内循环体总次数 = 外层次数 × 内层次数。
  • 三层：三个相乘。
  • 内层范围依赖 i（如 range(1, i+1)）：要逐次相加，1+2+…+n = n(n+1)/2。
  • “from 1 to 5” 有 5 个值；range(1,5) 只有 4 个。

考试写法：Number of times the inner loop body is executed = number of repetitions of the outer loop × number of repetitions of the inner loop.

ex.q: for i in range(0,5): for j in range(0,10): print('*'). How many stars?
ex.a:
1. Outer 5, inner 10.
  2. 5 × 10 = 50.

1. Inner count changes with i: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5.
  2. Add: 1+2+3+4+5 = 15.
ex.az:
1. 内层次数随 i 变：1..5。
  2. 相加得 15。

ex.q: A student says the code above prints 5 × 5 = 25 stars. Why wrong?
ex.a:
1. Multiplying only works when the inner range is fixed.
  2. Here the inner range is range(0, i), so it grows each time.
  3. You must add the passes: 15.
ex.az:
1. 只有内层范围固定才能相乘。
  2. 这里随 i 变，要相加：15。

cards.en:
A clock works like a nested loop. The minute hand is the outer loop; the second hand is the inner loop. Each time the minute hand moves one mark, the second hand makes a full turn of 60.

  • Add the hour hand → a three-level nested loop: 12 × 60 × 60 = 43 200 seconds.
  • The innermost counter changes fastest, like the last digit of a car odometer.

Exam wording: The innermost loop counter changes fastest.
cards.zh:
时钟就像嵌套循环。分针是外循环，秒针是内循环。分针走一格，秒针已转完 60 格。

  • 加上时针 → 三层：12×60×60 = 43200 秒。
  • 最内层计数器变得最快，像里程表最后一位。

考试写法：The innermost loop counter changes fastest.

ex.q: Print every time from 0:00 to 1:59 as m:s. How many lines?
ex.a:
1. Outer m in range(0, 2), inner s in range(0, 60).
  2. 2 × 60 = 120 lines.
  3. s changes fastest.
ex.az:
1. m 外层，s 内层。
  2. 2×60=120 行。

ex.q: Which line comes right after 0:59?
ex.a:
1. Inner loop ends after s = 59.
  2. m goes to 1, s restarts at 0.
  3. Next line: 1:0.
ex.az:
1. s=59 后内层结束。
  2. m 变 1，s 重新从 0 开始 → 1:0。

ex.q: A student puts the second loop outside and minute loop inside. What changes?
ex.a:
1. Now m changes fastest: 0:0, 1:0, 0:1, 1:1 …
  2. Still 120 lines, but the order is wrong for a clock.
  3. Rule: the fastest-changing value must be the innermost loop.
ex.az:
1. m 变最快：0:0, 1:0, 0:1…
  2. 仍 120 行，但次序不像时钟。
  3. 变最快的要放最内层。

cards.tz: 三层循环与倒数内循环
cards.en:
Loops can go three (or more) levels deep, like hours › minutes › seconds.

  • i, j, k each in range(0, 2) → 2 × 2 × 2 = 8 lines: 000, 001, 010, 011, 100, … 111. k changes fastest.
  • Count down with a negative step: range(3, 0, -1) → 3, 2, 1.
  • Outer and inner can have different lengths: outer range(0,3) with inner range(0,2) → 0 0, 0 1, 1 0, 1 1, 2 0, 2 1.

Exam wording: Total repetitions of the innermost body = product of the repetitions of all levels.
cards.zh:
循环可以三层或更多，像 时 › 分 › 秒。

  • i, j, k 都是 range(0,2) → 8 行 000…111，k 变最快。
  • 负 step 倒数：range(3, 0, -1) → 3,2,1。
  • 内外层长度可以不同。

考试写法：Total repetitions of the innermost body = product of the repetitions of all levels.

ex.q: 5th line of the 3-level i, j, k loop?
Output of for i in range(2): for j in range(2, 0, -1): print(i, j)
A student says the 3-level loop prints 2 + 2 + 2 = 6 lines. Fix.
ex.a:
1. Nested levels multiply, they do not add.
  2. 2 × 2 × 2 = 8.
  3. Adding is only for loops written one after another (not nested).
ex.az:
1. 嵌套要相乘：8 行。
  2. 相加只适用于先后排列（非嵌套）的循环。

cards.en:
Typing on a keyboard: you type stars across a line, then press Enter. end="" means "don't press Enter yet"; an empty print() means "press Enter".

  • print() adds a newline by default.
  • print("*", end="") keeps the next output on the same line.
  • print() outputs only a newline.

Method: first write a loop that prints ONE row; then wrap it in a loop that repeats the row.

Exam wording: The inner loop prints one row; the outer loop repeats the row L times.
cards.zh:
像打字：一行打星号，再按 Enter。end="" = 先不按 Enter；空 print() = 按 Enter。

  • print() 默认加换行。
  • print("*", end="") 下个输出留在同一行。
  • print() 只输出换行。

方法：先写印一行的循环，再用外循环重复。

考试写法：The inner loop prints one row; the outer loop repeats the row L times.

ex.q: Write a program for an L × L star square.
ex.a:
L = int(input())
for i in range(0, L):
    for j in range(0, L):
        print("*", end="")
    print()
  1. Inner: one row of L stars.
  2. print(): end the row.
  3. Outer: L rows.
ex.az: 内层印一行，print() 换行，外层 L 行。

ex.q: Output of print('a', end='-'); print('b')?
ex.a:
1. 'a' is followed by '-' instead of a newline.
  2. Output a-b.
ex.az: end 换成 '-'：a-b。

ex.q: A student indents print() by 8 spaces (inside the inner loop). L = 3: what happens?
ex.a:
1. A newline is printed after every star.
  2. Output: 9 lines with one * each.
  3. Fix: print() belongs to the outer body (4 spaces), after the inner loop.
ex.az:
1. 每颗星后都换行，变 9 行单星。
  2. print() 应缩进 4 格，在内循环之后。

cards.tz: 画长方形与直角三角形
cards.en:
Change the loop ranges, change the shape. Ask: what does row i look like?

ShapeOuterInner (stars in row i)
Rectangle W × LL rowsW
Right triangle height Hi = 1..Hi
Inverted trianglei = 1..HH − i + 1

In a triangle the inner range depends on the outer counter.

Exam wording: The number of repetitions of the inner loop depends on the outer loop counter i.
cards.zh:
改范围就改图形。先问：第 i 行长什么样？

  • 长方形 W×L：外层 L 行，内层 W 星。
  • 直角三角形高 H：第 i 行 i 星。
  • 倒三角：第 i 行 H−i+1 星。

三角形的内层范围依赖外层计数器。

考试写法：The number of repetitions of the inner loop depends on the outer loop counter i.

ex.q: Triangle of height H in Python.
ex.a:
H = int(input())
for i in range(1, H + 1):
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        print("*", end="")
    print()
H = 3 → *, **, ***.
ex.az: 内层 range(1, i+1)。

ex.q: Inverted triangle, H = 4: stars per row?
ex.a:
1. Row i has H − i + 1.
  2. i = 1..4 → 4, 3, 2, 1.
  3. Inner: range(1, H - i + 2).

ex.q: Rectangle W = 5, L = 2. A student writes for i in range(W): for j in range(L). Output?
ex.a:
1. Outer runs W = 5 times → 5 rows.
  2. Each row has L = 2 stars.
  3. Shape is 2 wide × 5 tall – rotated. Fix: outer = rows (L), inner = stars per row (W).
ex.az:
1. 变成 5 行 × 2 星，转了 90 度。
  2. 外层 = 行数 L，内层 = 每行星数 W。

notes.tz: 第 i 行 i 颗星。

cards.t: Accessing a 2D array with nested for loops
cards.tz: 用嵌套 for 访问二维数组
cards.en:
A 2D array is like a cinema: rows and seats. To visit every seat, walk row by row, and in each row seat by seat.

  • Outer counter i = row index; inner counter j = column index.
  • Python writes num[i][j]; pseudocode writes num[i,j].
  • i outer, j inner → row by row (row-major). j outer, i inner → column by column.
  • Either way every item is visited once, so a sum or count is the same; only the order changes.

Exam wording: We use a nested for loop to access items in a two-dimensional array one by one.
cards.zh:
二维数组像戏院：行与座位。要走遍每个座位，就一行一行，每行一个一个座位。

  • 外层 i = 行 index；内层 j = 列 index。
  • Python 写 num[i][j]，伪代码写 num[i,j]。
  • i 外 j 内 → 逐行；j 外 i 内 → 逐列。
  • 每格都只访问一次，求和结果一样，只是次序不同。

考试写法：We use a nested for loop to access items in a two-dimensional array one by one.

ex.q: for i from 0 to 2 / for j from 0 to 5 / num[i,j] ← i*j. What is row 2?
A = [[1,2],[3,4]]. Order of items printed with j outer, i inner?
ex.a:
1. j = 0: A[0][0], A[1][0] → 1, 3.
  2. j = 1: 2, 4.
  3. Output 1 3 2 4 (column by column).

ex.q: A student writes num[j][i] for a 3-row × 6-column list with i in range(3), j in range(6). What happens?
ex.a:
1. The first index is the row, which only goes to 2.
  2. j reaches 3 → IndexError: list index out of range.
  3. Fix: num[i][j] (row first).
ex.az:
1. 第一个 index 是行，最大 2。
  2. j=3 时 IndexError。
  3. 改 num[i][j]。

notes.t: Item at row i, column j.
notes.tz: 第 i 行第 j 列。

cards.tz: 二维 list 的初始化
cards.en:
Before you put books on a shelf, the shelf must exist. In Python you cannot write num[2][3] = 5 unless that slot already exists.

  • Initialisation = creating the list and giving every item a default value (e.g. 0) first.
  • The outer loop body adds a row; the inner loop body adds a column.

Exam wording: Initialisation is the process of creating a list and assigning default values before its items can be accessed.
cards.zh:
放书前要先有书架。Python 里位置不存在就不能写 num[2][3] = 5。

  • Initialisation 初始化：先建 list，每格给默认值（如 0）。
  • 外循环体加一行，内循环体加一列。

考试写法：Initialisation is the process of creating a list and assigning default values before its items can be accessed.

ex.q: Outer range(0,2), inner range(0,3). Final num?
ex.az: 2 行 3 列全 0。

ex.q: After initialising 3 × 6, run num[i][j] = i * j in the same loops. num[2]?
A student writes num = [] then num[0][0] = 1. What happens?
ex.a:
1. num has no row 0 yet.
  2. IndexError: list index out of range.
  3. Fix: initialise first (nested loop or [[0]*6 for i in range(3)]).
ex.az:
1. 还没有第 0 行 → IndexError。
  2. 先初始化。

code.src:
num = []
for i in range(0, 3):
    num = num + [[]]
    for j in range(0, 6):
        num[i] = num[i] + [0]
        num[i][j] = i * j
print(num)

notes.t: Add a 0 to row i (creates the slot).
notes.tz: 在第 i 行加 0（建立位置）。

notes.t: Now the slot exists, assign i*j.

cards.t: Sum of a 2D array (row vs column order)
cards.tz: 二维数组求和（逐行/逐列）
cards.en:
Count the books on a bookshelf with 3 shelves × 6 boxes: keep one running total and add each box.

  1. total ← 0 before both loops.
  2. Nested loop: total ← total + B[i,j].
  3. Output total after the loops.

Swapping the loops (j outer) still gives the right total: every cell is still added once.

Exam wording: The accumulator must be initialised outside (before) the nested loop.
cards.zh:
数书架 3 层 × 6 格的书：用一个累加器逐格加。

  1. 两层循环之前 total ← 0。
  2. 嵌套循环里 total ← total + B[i,j]。
  3. 循环后输出。

对调内外层，结果仍正确。

考试写法：The accumulator must be initialised outside (before) the nested loop.

ex.a:
1. Row sums: 32, 26, 37.
  2. Total = 95.

ex.q: Find the total of column 2 only.
ex.a:
1. Single loop over i with j fixed at 2.
  2. 6 + 8 + 5 = 19.

ex.q: A student puts total = 0 inside the outer loop. Output?
ex.a:
1. total is reset at the start of every row.
  2. Only the last row's sum remains: 37.
  3. Fix: move total = 0 before the outer loop.
ex.az:
1. 每行重设，只剩最后一行 37。
  2. 移到外循环之前。

notes.t: Add the books in this box.

cards.en:
A multiplication table is a grid where each cell = row number × column number. The value comes from the indexes.

  • Pseudocode (1-based): for i from 1 to 10 / for j from 1 to 10 / M[i,j] ← i * j.
  • Python lists start at 0: store at M[i-1][j-1], or build each row and append it.

Exam wording: M[i, j] ← i * j
cards.zh:
乘法表每格 = 行号 × 列号，数值由 index 计出。

  • 伪代码（从 1 开始）：M[i,j] ← i*j。
  • Python 从 0 开始：存 M[i-1][j-1]，或逐行建立再加入。

考试写法：M[i, j] ← i * j

ex.q: times_table(3)?
In a 10 × 10 table (1-based), what is M[7,8]? Where is it in Python?
ex.a:
1. 7 × 8 = 56.
  2. Python: M[6][7].
ex.az: 56；Python 位置 M[6][7]。

ex.q: A student writes row = [] before the outer loop instead of inside it. times_table(2)?
ex.a:
1. row is never emptied, so it keeps growing.
  2. t = [[1,2],[1,2,2,4]].
  3. Fix: reset row = [] at the start of each outer pass.
ex.az:
1. row 没清空，越来越长。
  2. row=[] 要放在外循环体开头。

notes.t: Function for an n × n table.

cards.t: Bingo: checking whole rows with a flag
cards.en:
Bingo: you win if a whole row is crossed. Start each row believing "this row is full", and change your mind at the first gap.

A flag variable is a Boolean that records whether something has happened.

  1. win ← False before the loops.
  2. For each row: row ← True (reset inside the outer loop).
  3. Any False cell → row ← False.
  4. After the inner loop: if row is still True → win ← True.

This for-loop version always checks all 25 cells.

Exam wording: A flag variable is used to record whether a condition has occurred.
cards.zh:
Bingo：整行打勾就赢。每行开始先假设“这行满了”，见到一个空格就改。

Flag variable：记录某事有没有发生的 Boolean。

  1. 循环前 win ← False。
  2. 每行开始 row ← True（在外循环里重设）。
  3. 遇 False → row ← False。
  4. 内循环之后判断 row。

考试写法：A flag variable is used to record whether a condition has occurred.

ex.q: In the code, which row makes win True?
ex.a:
1. Rows 0, 1, 3, 4 each have a False.
  2. Row 2 is all True → row stays True → win ← True.
  3. Output True.
ex.az: 第 2 行全 True，输出 True。

ex.q: How many cells are checked?
ex.a:
1. The for loops never stop early.
  2. 5 × 5 = 25.
ex.az: 25 格全查。

ex.q: A student sets row = True once, before the outer loop. Effect?
ex.a:
1. Row 0 has a False → row becomes False.
  2. It is never reset, so even the full row 2 cannot make it True again.
  3. Output False – wrong. Reset the flag at the start of every row.
ex.az:
1. row 只设一次，第 0 行就变 False，之后永不恢复。
  2. 输出 False，错。每行开始要重设。

code.src:
result = [[True, False, True, False, True],
          [False, True, False, True, False],
          [True, True, True, True, True],
          [False, False, True, False, True],
          [True, False, False, True, False]]
win = False
for i in range(0, 5):
    row = True
    for j in range(0, 5):
        if result[i][j] == False:
            row = False
    if row == True:
        win = True
print(win)

notes.t: Then the row is not full.

demo.src:
result = [[True, False, True, False, True],
          [False, True, False, True, False],
          [True, True, True, True, True],
          [False, False, True, False, True],
          [True, False, False, True, False]]
win = False
for i in range(0, 5):
    row = True
    for j in range(0, 5):
        if result[i][j] == False:
            row = False
    if row == True:
        win = True
print(win)

cards.t: Bingo: early stopping with while loops
cards.en:
When checking a column, once you see one gap you can stop looking at that column. Once you find a full column, you can stop the whole game check.

  • Outer: while j <= 4 and win == False – stops when a full column is found.
  • Inner: while i <= 4 and col == True – stops at the first False cell.
  • Inside: assume win ← True; col ← True; a False cell sets both to False.

Exam wording: On average this is quicker, because once an item is found to be False, or a fully crossed column is found, the loop stops.
cards.zh:
查一列时见到一个空格就不用再看；找到整列就整个停止。

  • 外层 while j≤4 and win==False：找到整列就停。
  • 内层 while i≤4 and col==True：遇第一个 False 就停。
  • 先假设 win、col 为 True，遇 False 两个都改 False。

考试写法：On average this is quicker, because once an item is found to be False, or a fully crossed column is found, the loop stops.

ex.q: Trace the code: which column wins and how many cells are checked?
ex.a:
1. Col 0: (0,0) True, (1,0) False → stop, 2 checks.
  2. Col 1: (0,1) False → 1 check. Col 2: T, F → 2 checks.
  3. Col 3: all True → 5 checks, win True, outer stops.
  4. Output True 10 (vs 25 with for loops).
ex.az:
1. 第 0 列 2 次、第 1 列 1 次、第 2 列 2 次、第 3 列全满 5 次。
  2. 输出 True 10。

ex.q: Worst case number of checks?
ex.a:
1. Every column is full until its last cell, or no early stop happens.
  2. Up to 25, same as the for version.
ex.az: 最坏仍 25 次。

ex.q: Why must the outer condition include win == False? What if it is removed?
ex.a:
1. Without it, the loop goes on to column 4.
  2. Column 4 has a False, which sets win back to False.
  3. Output would be wrong (False). The condition stops the loop as soon as win is True.
ex.az:
1. 去掉后会继续查第 4 列，把 win 改回 False。
  2. 结果错。

code.src:
result = [[True, False, True, True, True],
          [False, True, False, True, False],
          [True, True, False, True, True],
          [False, False, True, True, True],
          [True, False, False, True, False]]
win = False
checks = 0
j = 0
while j <= 4 and win == False:
    win = True
    col = True
    i = 0
    while i <= 4 and col == True:
        checks = checks + 1
        if result[i][j] == False:
            col = False
            win = False
        i = i + 1
    j = j + 1
print(win, checks)

notes.tz: 第 4 行（第 3 列全满）。

notes.t: Stop when columns run out or a win is found.

demo.src:
result = [[True, False, True, True, True],
          [False, True, False, True, False],
          [True, True, False, True, True],
          [False, False, True, True, True],
          [True, False, False, True, False]]
win = False
checks = 0
j = 0
while j <= 4 and win == False:
    win = True
    col = True
    i = 0
    while i <= 4 and col == True:
        checks = checks + 1
        if result[i][j] == False:
            col = False
            win = False
        i = i + 1
    j = j + 1
print(win, checks)

cards.en:
A diagonal is a staircase across the grid: one step down, one step right. Because one index decides the other, you need only one loop.

  • Top-left → bottom-right: row = column → r[i][i].
  • Top-right → bottom-left: r[i][n-1-i] (5×5: r[i][4-i]).
  • Use a flag; check the second diagonal only if the first failed.

Exam wording: For an n × n array, the anti-diagonal items are r[i][n−1−i]; a single loop is enough.
cards.zh:
对角线像楼梯：下一格、右一格。一个 index 决定另一个，所以一层循环就够。

  • 左上→右下：r[i][i]。
  • 右上→左下：r[i][n-1-i]（5×5 为 4-i）。
  • 用 flag；第一条失败才查第二条。

考试写法：For an n × n array, the anti-diagonal items are r[i][n−1−i]; a single loop is enough.

ex.q: Which cells form the anti-diagonal of a 5×5 array?
Run the code. Output?
ex.a:
1. Main diagonal: r[4][4] is False → win False.
  2. Anti-diagonal: (0,4),(1,3),(2,2),(3,1),(4,0) all True.
  3. Output True.
ex.az: 主对角线失败，副对角线全 True → True。

ex.q: A student uses a nested loop for i.. for j..: if r[i][j]==False to check the main diagonal. What is wrong?
ex.a:
1. That checks all 25 cells, not just the diagonal.
  2. Any False anywhere makes win False.
  3. Fix: single loop with r[i][i].
ex.az:
1. 查了全部 25 格，不只对角线。
  2. 用单层循环 r[i][i]。

cards.en:
Take the rows of a tic-tac-toe board and lay them end to end in one long line. Row 0 first, then row 1, then row 2.

  • 0-based, n columns: k = i × n + j. Back: i = k // n, j = k % n.
  • 1-based (textbook): ttt_1d[(i-1)*3 + j] ← ttt_2d[i,j]; general (i-1)*n + j.
  • An m × n array becomes a 1D array of m × n items.
  • Row win check: three cells not empty and all equal.

Exam wording: ttt_1d[(i−1)*n + j] ← ttt_2d[i, j] copies the 2D array row by row into the 1D array.
cards.zh:
把井字棋的行首尾相接排成一条：先第 0 行，再第 1、2 行。

  • 0-based、n 列：k = i×n + j；反向 i = k // n, j = k % n。
  • 课本 1-based：(i-1)*n + j。
  • m×n 变成 m×n 个元素的一维数组。
  • 行胜利：三格非空且相同。

考试写法：ttt_1d[(i−1)*n + j] ← ttt_2d[i, j] copies the 2D array row by row into the 1D array.

ex.q: 0-based, n = 5. Where does cell (2, 3) go? Which cell is index 17?
A 4 × 5 array (1-based) becomes 1D. Size? Where does [4,5] go?
ex.a:
1. Size 4 × 5 = 20.
  2. (4 − 1) × 5 + 5 = 20 (the last slot).

ex.q: A student uses k = i × 3 + j but with i = row in 1-based and j 1-based: (1,1) → 4. Why is this wrong?
ex.a:
1. With 1-based indexes the first row must start at 1.
  2. (1,1) should map to 1, so use (i − 1) × 3 + j.
  3. Mixing 0-based and 1-based formulas shifts everything by one row.
ex.az:
1. 1-based 要用 (i−1)×3+j。
  2. 混用会整体错一行。

code.src:
ttt_2d = [['X', 'O', 'X'],
          ['O', 'X', 'O'],
          ['', '', 'X']]
ttt_1d = [''] * 9
for i in range(0, 3):
    for j in range(0, 3):
        ttt_1d[i * 3 + j] = ttt_2d[i][j]
print(ttt_1d)
k = 7
print(k // 3, k % 3)

demo.src:
ttt_2d = [['X', 'O', 'X'],
          ['O', 'X', 'O'],
          ['', '', 'X']]
ttt_1d = [''] * 9
for i in range(0, 3):
    for j in range(0, 3):
        ttt_1d[i * 3 + j] = ttt_2d[i][j]
print(ttt_1d)
k = 7
print(k // 3, k % 3)

cards.en:
A picture is a 2D array of pixels. Fold it down the middle like paper: the left half is copied to the right half.

  • art[i,7-j] ← art[i,j] reflects an 8-wide image along the line between j = 3 and j = 4.
  • Run j only from 0 to 3: j = 4..7 would just copy the right half back – wasted work. Changing the inner loop to j from 0 to 3 improves efficiency.
  • Symmetry check: flag True; if art[i,j] != art[i,7-j] for any j in 0..3 → False.

Exam wording: Only half of the columns need to be processed, so the inner loop can run from 0 to 3 to improve efficiency.
cards.zh:
图片是像素的二维数组。像折纸一样沿中线对折：左半复制到右半。

  • art[i,7-j] ← art[i,j]：沿 j=3 与 j=4 之间镜像。
  • j 只需 0..3，4..7 只是复制回去，浪费。
  • 对称检查：flag，任何 art[i,j]≠art[i,7-j] 就 False。

考试写法：Only half of the columns need to be processed, so the inner loop can run from 0 to 3 to improve efficiency.

ex.q: Row is F F T F F F F F. After reflection?
ex.a:
1. Only j = 2 is T.
  2. Cell 7 − 2 = 5 becomes T.
  3. F F T F F T F F.
ex.az: j=2 复制到 5：F F T F F T F F。

ex.q: Is row F T F F F F T F symmetric?
ex.a:
1. j=0 vs 7: F,F. j=1 vs 6: T,T. j=2 vs 5: F,F. j=3 vs 4: F,F.
  2. All equal → True.
ex.az: 四对都相同 → True。

ex.q: A student uses art[i][8-j] for an 8-wide image. Problem?
ex.a:
1. Columns are 0..7. When j = 0, 8 − 0 = 8 is out of range → IndexError.
  2. The mirror of j is 7 − j (width − 1 − j).
ex.az:
1. j=0 时 index 8 越界。
  2. 镜像是 7−j。

cards.en:
A recipe has steps in order, choices ("if no eggs, use milk") and repeats ("stir 10 times"). Programs are the same.

Control flow = the order in which statements are executed. Three structures change it:

StructurePythonMeaning
Sequencelines one after anotherrun in order
Selectionif / elif / elsechoose a path
Iterationfor / whilerepeat a body

Combined with 1D/2D arrays and nested many levels deep, they solve real problems (robots, games, images).

Exam wording: No matter how complex a program is, it can be constructed using the three control structures: sequence, selection and iteration.
cards.zh:
食谱有顺序步骤、选择（没蛋就用奶）、重复（搅 10 下）。程序也一样。

Control flow = 语句执行的次序。三种结构：sequence 顺序、selection 选择（if）、iteration 迭代（for/while）。配合一维/二维数组多层嵌套，能解决实际问题。

考试写法：No matter how complex a program is, it can be constructed using the three control structures: sequence, selection and iteration.

ex.q: Name the structures in: while y<10: x=0; while x<10: for i..: for j..: if i<=9 and j<=9: F[i][j]=1
ex.a:
1. Iteration: two while, two for.
  2. Selection: the if.
  3. Sequence: x=0, the assignments in order.
  4. All three, four loops deep.
ex.az: 迭代、选择、顺序三种都有。

ex.q: Which structure: for i in range(5): print(i)?
ex.a:
1. The for repeats → iteration.
  2. (The body itself is a sequence of one statement.)
ex.az: 迭代。

ex.q: A student says "a function call is a fourth control structure". Respond.
ex.a:
1. The three structures are sequence, selection and iteration.
  2. A function is a way to group code; inside, it is still built from the three.
  3. Exam answer: only three.
ex.az:
1. 只有三种。
  2. 函数只是把代码分组，里面仍由三种组成。

cards.t: Sowing robot: while loops containing for loops
cards.tz: 播种机器人：while 包着 for
cards.en:
A farm is a 10 × 10 grid F. A robot sows seeds in 2 × 2 patches with 2-cell gaps. Peel the program like an onion, from the inside out.

  1. Innermost two for loops: mark a 2 × 2 square at (x, y).
  2. Inner while: move 4 columns right (2 sown + 2 gap).
  3. Outer while: move 4 rows down.

Result: 2 × 2 blocks at rows/columns 0-1, 4-5, 8-9.

Exam wording: Analyse the program layer by layer from the innermost loop outwards.
cards.zh:
农田是 10×10 网格 F。机器人播 2×2 小块，间隔 2 格。像剥洋葱一样由内而外分析。

  1. 最内两个 for：在 (x,y) 画 2×2。
  2. 内层 while：右移 4 列。
  3. 外层 while：下移 4 行。

考试写法：Analyse the program layer by layer from the innermost loop outwards.

ex.q: How many cells become 1?
ex.a:
1. y = 0, 4, 8 and x = 0, 4, 8 → 3 × 3 = 9 squares.
  2. Each 4 cells → 36.
  3. 8 + 1 = 9, so nothing goes out of range.

ex.q: What is printed for row 4?
ex.a:
1. Row 4 is in the y = 4 square.
  2. Columns 0-1, 4-5, 8-9 are 1.
  3. 1100110011.

ex.q: A student changes x = x + 4 to x = x + 2. Effect?
ex.a:
1. Squares now start at x = 0, 2, 4, 6, 8: no gaps.
  2. Each sown row becomes 1111111111.
  3. The step must be square size + gap = 2 + 2 = 4.
ex.az:
1. 没有间隔，整行都是 1。
  2. 步长 = 方块 + 间隔 = 4。

cards.en:
Now the user picks the square size n. Replace every fixed 2 with n.

  • Square: for i from y to y+n-1, for j from x to x+n-1.
  • Step = square + gap: x ← x + n*2, y ← y + n*2.
  • 10 is not always a multiple of 2n, so a square can hang off the edge → add if i <= 9 and j <= 9.

Exam wording: Add the condition i <= 9 and j <= 9 to avoid accessing items outside the array.
cards.zh:
由用户输入方块大小 n，把固定的 2 换成 n。

  • 方块：y..y+n-1、x..x+n-1。
  • 步长：n*2。
  • 10 不一定是 2n 的倍数，方块会超出边界 → 加 if i≤9 and j≤9。

考试写法：Add the condition i <= 9 and j <= 9 to avoid accessing items outside the array.

ex.q: n = 4: how many cells are sown?
ex.a:
1. Squares start at 0 and 8.
  2. Rows/cols 0-3 and 8-11, but 10-11 are cut → {0..3, 8, 9}: 6 values.
  3. 6 × 6 = 36.

ex.q: n = 3: how many?
ex.a:
1. Starts 0 and 6; rows 0-2 and 6-8 (all inside).
  2. 6 × 6 = 36.

ex.q: A student leaves out the if i <= 9 and j <= 9. n = 4?
ex.a:
1. The square at 8 tries row 10.
  2. IndexError: list index out of range.
  3. The guard is needed whenever an index is computed.
ex.az: 1. 第 10 行不存在 → IndexError。

cards.en:
You can't sit in seat 11 of a 10-seat row. Items that do not exist in the array cannot be accessed.

  • Python: index outside 0..size−1 → IndexError: list index out of range.
  • Guard any computed index (i+k, j+k, y+n−1).
  • Short-circuit evaluation: Python stops an or at the first True part, an and at the first False part. So put the range test first.
  • Negative indexes don't crash in Python; they silently read from the end – a logic error.

Exam wording: Check the index range first so that items whose indexes are out of range are not accessed.
cards.zh:
一排只有 10 个座位，坐不到第 11 号。不存在的元素不能访问。

  • 越界 → IndexError。
  • 计算出来的 index 都要保护。
  • 短路求值：or 遇 True 就停，and 遇 False 就停 → 范围测试放前面。
  • 负 index 不报错，但会从尾部读，是逻辑错误。

考试写法：Check the index range first so that items whose indexes are out of range are not accessed.

ex.q: s = 'ABC'. Is if i < len(s) and s[i] == 'C' safe for i = 5?
ex.a:
1. i < 3 is False.
  2. and stops; s[5] is never read.
  3. Safe: result False.
ex.az: 第一部分 False，and 停止，安全。

ex.q: row = [1,2,3]. What does row[-1] give, and why can it be a bug?
ex.a:
1. -1 means the last item → 3.
  2. If j − 1 became −1 by accident, you read the wrong cell without any error.
ex.az: row[-1]=3；不报错但读错格。

ex.q: Why does this crash for a word running past column 9? if word[k] != puzzle[i][j+k] or j+k >= 10:
ex.a:
1. puzzle[i][j+k] is evaluated first → IndexError.
  2. Swap: if j+k >= 10 or word[k] != puzzle[i][j+k]:
  3. Now when j+k >= 10 is True, the rest is skipped.
ex.az:
1. 先读了越界元素。
  2. 先检查 j+k≥10。

row = ['N', 'E', 'T']
word = 'NETX'
ok = True
for k in range(0, len(word)):
    if k >= len(row) or word[k] != row[k]:
        ok = False
print(ok)

cards.en:
Checking a password is like checking a key, tooth by tooth. And a key that is too short or too long is wrong too.

  1. correct ← True.
  2. For each position j of password: if lengths differ OR characters differ → correct ← False.

The length test catches "ilove" (a prefix) and "iloveict123" (extra letters). Putting it first also stops reading past the end of a shorter input.

Exam wording: Compare the lengths first, then compare the characters one by one; any difference sets the flag to False.
cards.zh:
核对密码像逐齿核对钥匙；太短或太长也不对。

  1. correct ← True。
  2. 每个位置：长度不同 或 字符不同 → False。

长度测试挡住 "ilove"、"iloveict123"；放前面也避免越界。

考试写法：Compare the lengths first, then compare the characters one by one; any difference sets the flag to False.

ex.q: Input 'iloveicx'?
ex.a:
1. Lengths both 8.
  2. Last char 't' ≠ 'x' → False.
  3. Output False.
ex.az: 最后一字不同 → False。

ex.q: Input 'iloveict'?
ex.a:
1. Same length, every character equal.
  2. Flag never changes → True.
ex.az: 全相同 → True。

ex.q: A student drops the length test. Input 'iloveict123'?
ex.a:
1. Loop compares only the 8 password positions; all match.
  2. Output True – a wrong password is accepted.
  3. Input 'ilove' would crash with IndexError. Keep the length test first.
ex.az:
1. 多了字也被接受；短的会越界。
  2. 长度测试必须保留并放前面。

code.src:
password = 'iloveict'
input_pw = input()
correct = True
for j in range(0, len(password)):
    if len(password) != len(input_pw) or password[j] != input_pw[j]:
        correct = False
print(correct)

notes.t: Length differs OR char differs (length first).
notes.tz: 长度不同或字符不同（长度先）。

correct = True

cards.t: Finding a word in a string
cards.en:
Looking for a friend in a crowd: when you see someone with the right hair, you assume it's them and then check the face. If the face is wrong, keep looking.

  1. found ← False.
  2. At each position i whose letter matches the first letter (and not yet found): assume found.
  3. Check every letter; any mismatch or running past the end → found ← False.

found == False in the outer test stops new checks once the word is found.

Exam wording: Assume the word is found when the first letter matches, then compare every letter; the length condition avoids reading items whose indexes are out of range.
cards.zh:
在人群找朋友：见到发型对就假设是他，再看脸；不对就继续找。

  1. found ← False。
  2. 首字母相同且未找到 → 先假设找到。
  3. 逐字核对，不同或超出尾部 → False。

考试写法：Assume the word is found when the first letter matches, then compare every letter; the length condition avoids reading items whose indexes are out of range.

ex.q: find('gjbcomputers','computer')?
ex.a:
1. i = 3 is 'c' → assume True.
  2. 'computer' matches s[3..10].
  3. True.
ex.az: i=3 起完全相同 → True。

ex.q: find('cocoa','cola')?
ex.a:
1. i=0 'c': 'co' ok, 'c' ≠ 'l' → False.
  2. i=2 'c': 'co' ok, 'a' ≠ 'l' → False.
  3. False.
ex.az: 两处都失败 → False。

ex.q: A student removes and found == False. What does find('cat c', 'cat') return?
ex.a:
1. i = 0: 'cat' matches → found True.
  2. i = 4: 'c' matches w[0] again → found set True, then k = 1 runs past the end → found False.
  3. Wrong answer False. The guard stops new checks once the word has been found.
ex.az:
1. i=0 已找到；i=4 又遇 'c'，越过尾部把 found 改回 False。
  2. 要保留 found==False。

notes.tz: 函数：w 是否在 s 里。

notes.t: First letter matches and not found yet.
Past end OR mismatch (range test first).

cards.en:
In a word-search puzzle you scan every starting cell and look right, down and diagonally.

Puzzle = list of strings; puzzle[i][j] = row i, column j. For each start (i, j) and each k:

DirectionCellGuard
Row →puzzle[i][j+k]j+k >= 10
Column ↓puzzle[i+k][j]i+k >= 10
Diagonal ↘puzzle[i+k][j+k]i+k >= 10 or j+k >= 10

Three nested loops (i, j, k) with selection inside: all control structures plus a 2D data structure.

Exam wording: For each starting cell, compare word[k] with puzzle[i][j+k] (row), puzzle[i+k][j] (column) or puzzle[i+k][j+k] (diagonal), checking the range first.
cards.zh:
找字游戏：每个起点都向右、向下、斜向看。

  • 行：puzzle[i][j+k]，保护 j+k≥10。
  • 列：puzzle[i+k][j]，保护 i+k≥10。
  • 对角：puzzle[i+k][j+k]，两者都保护。

三层循环 + if：控制结构与二维数据结构的综合。

考试写法：For each starting cell, compare word[k] with puzzle[i][j+k] (row), puzzle[i+k][j] (column) or puzzle[i+k][j+k] (diagonal), checking the range first.

ex.q: Run the code. What is printed?
ex.a:
1. Row 0 starts 'CAT' → row at 0 0.
  2. Diagonal from (0,0): C, puzzle[1][1]='X' → no.
  3. Output: row at 0 0 only.
ex.az: 只输出 row at 0 0。

ex.q: Which expression reads a word written bottom-to-top in a column?
ex.a:
1. Move up: puzzle[i-k][j].
  2. Guard: i-k < 0 (negative indexes would wrap round).
ex.az: puzzle[i-k][j]，保护 i-k<0。

ex.q: A student guards the diagonal with only j+k >= 4. Start (3,0), word 'XX'?
ex.a:
1. k=1: j+k = 1 fine, but i+k = 4 → puzzle[4] → IndexError.
  2. Diagonal moves in both directions, so guard both i+k and j+k.
ex.az:
1. i+k=4 越界。
  2. 对角线两个 index 都要保护。

cards.en:
Slide a small stencil over a big picture. At each position, check if every pixel of the stencil matches what is under it. This is the basis of simple image recognition.

  • Pattern pixel (p, q) sits over photo pixel (i + p, j + q) (0-based). Textbook 1-based: photo[i-1+p, j-1+q].
  • Valid corners: i from 0 to R − h, j from 0 to C − w, so the window stays inside.
  • Two loops for the corner + two for the pattern = four-level nested loop.

Exam wording: For each possible top-left corner, compare every item of the pattern with the corresponding item of the photo; any difference sets match to False.
cards.zh:
把小模板在大图上滑动，每个位置看模板每个像素是否和下面一样。这是简单图像识别的基础。

  • 模板 (p,q) 对应照片 (i+p, j+q)。
  • 角落范围：i 0..R−h，j 0..C−w。
  • 四层嵌套循环。

考试写法：For each possible top-left corner, compare every item of the pattern with the corresponding item of the photo; any difference sets match to False.

ex.q: 3×3 window in a 4×8 photo: how many corners?
Run the code: how many times does the 2×2 block of 1s appear?
ex.a:
1. Corners (0,1) and (0,4) match.
  2. Output 2.

ex.q: A student loops corners with range(0, 3) and range(0, 6). Effect?
ex.a:
1. At i = 2, the pattern needs photo row 3 → IndexError.
  2. Corners must stop at R − h and C − w: range(0, R-h+1).
ex.az:
1. 窗口超出照片 → IndexError。
  2. 角落要到 R−h 为止。

cards.en:
There are many routes to school: fastest, cheapest, least walking. Algorithms too: one problem can be solved by several algorithms, each with merits and demerits.

Criteria:

  • Correctness – right output in every case, including special cases.
  • Appropriateness – fits the data and the user.
  • Steps / time of operation (time complexity).
  • Resource usage / memory (space complexity).
  • Data structures used.

Often a trade-off: faster may mean more memory.

Exam wording: We compare algorithms to select the most correct and appropriate solution, mainly in terms of steps of operation and resource usage.
cards.zh:
上学有很多路线：最快、最便宜、最少走路。算法也一样：一个问题可用多个算法解决，各有优缺点。

  • 正确性（含特殊情况）
  • 合适性
  • 运算步骤/时间（time complexity）
  • 资源/内存（space complexity）
  • 所用数据结构

常有取舍 trade-off。

考试写法：We compare algorithms to select the most correct and appropriate solution, mainly in terms of steps of operation and resource usage.

ex.q: List four criteria for comparing two algorithms.
ex.a:
1. Correctness.
  2. Time / steps of operation.
  3. Memory / resource usage.
  4. Appropriateness / data structures.
ex.az: 正确性、时间、内存、合适性。

ex.q: Algorithm X is twice as fast as Y but fails when the list is empty. Which to choose for a bank system?
ex.a:
1. Correctness comes first: a wrong answer is useless however fast.
  2. Choose Y (or fix X).
ex.az: 正确性优先，选 Y。

ex.q: A student writes "the shorter program is always the better algorithm". Correct this.
ex.a:
1. Fewer lines ≠ fewer steps: a short nested loop can run n² times.
  2. Compare steps executed and memory, not lines of code.
ex.az:
1. 行数少不等于步骤少。
  2. 要比较执行步骤与内存。

code.src:
data = [4, 9, 2]
print(max(data))
best = data[0]
for x in data:
    if x > best:
        best = x
print(best)

demo.src:

print(max(data))
best = data[0]

cards.en:
Washing 10 plates one by one is 10 steps; comparing every plate with every other is 100. More steps = longer time.

  • Estimate time by counting how many times the key line runs (e.g. a comparison).
  • Single loop over n → about n. Nested n × m → about n × m.
  • Two loops one after another → n + m (add, not multiply).
  • Loops that stop early (while + flag) reduce the average.

Exam wording: When there are more steps of operation, the program takes a longer time to run, which usually means a higher time complexity.
cards.zh:
逐只洗 10 只碟是 10 步；每只碟和每只比较是 100 步。步骤越多，时间越长。

  • 数关键语句执行次数估计时间。
  • 单层 n 次；嵌套 n×m 次。
  • 两个先后的循环：n+m。
  • 提早停止的循环降低平均次数。

考试写法：When there are more steps of operation, the program takes a longer time to run, which usually means a higher time complexity.

ex.q: n = 100: steps for X (nested) and Y (two separate loops)?
ex.a:
1. X: 100 × 100 = 10 000.
  2. Y: 100 + 100 = 200.
  3. Y has lower time complexity.
ex.az: X 一万，Y 两百。

ex.q: Missing-item nested algorithm: 10 numbers × 9 items. How many comparisons?
ex.a:
1. Outer 10, inner 9.
  2. 10 × 9 = 90.

ex.q: A student says Y is nested because it has two loops. Correct this.
ex.a:
1. Y's loops are one after another, not one inside the other.
  2. Steps add (n + n), they do not multiply.
  3. Check the indentation to see nesting.
ex.az:
1. Y 的两个循环是先后，不是嵌套。
  2. 次数相加。

notes.tz: Y 第二个循环（非嵌套）。

cards.en:
A note-taker who writes a big table on paper uses more paper but answers fast; one who recounts every time uses no paper but is slow.

  • A few simple variables → little memory.
  • An extra array (e.g. one counter per possible value) → memory that grows with the data.
  • Typical trade-off: extra array saves time but costs memory.

Exam wording: The more computer resources an algorithm occupies, the higher the space complexity of the program.
cards.zh:
把大表写在纸上：用纸多但答得快；每次重数：不用纸但慢。

  • 几个变量 → 内存少。
  • 额外数组 → 内存随数据增加。
  • 取舍：数组省时间但占内存。

考试写法：The more computer resources an algorithm occupies, the higher the space complexity of the program.

ex.q: P counts marks 0–100 with an array of 101 counters; Q re-scans the list for each mark. Compare.
ex.a:
1. P: extra 101-item array → higher space, one pass (less time).
  2. Q: few variables → lower space, 101 passes (more time).
ex.az: P 空间高时间少；Q 相反。

ex.q: Algorithm 1 uses only weight and total; algorithm 3 uses an array found[10]. Which has lower space complexity?
ex.a:
1. Algorithm 1: two variables.
  2. Algorithm 3: an extra array.
  3. Algorithm 1 requires less computer memory.
ex.az: 算法 1 内存较少。

ex.q: A student writes "Q uses less memory so Q is better". What is missing?
ex.a:
1. Only one criterion was compared.
  2. Q needs many more steps (higher time).
  3. A full answer mentions the trade-off and the situation.
ex.az:
1. 只比较了一项。
  2. 要提到取舍与情况。

cards.en:
A box should hold items numbered A to A+9; one is missing. Array C holds the 9 present numbers in random order.

  1. Algorithm 1 (sum): weight = A + … + (A+9); total = sum of C; answer = weight − total.
  2. Algorithm 2 (nested search): for each i from A to A+9, search all of C; not found → output i. 10 × 9 = 90 comparisons.
  3. Algorithm 3 (flag array): found[i] ← False for all; found[C[k]] ← True; output every i still False.

Exam wording: Algorithm 1 outputs weight − total, the number of the missing item.
cards.zh:
箱子应有 A 到 A+9 号；缺一件。C 存其余 9 个号码（乱序）。

  1. 算法 1（求和）：应有总和 − 实际总和。
  2. 算法 2（嵌套搜索）：每个号码都在 C 里找，90 次比较。
  3. 算法 3（flag 数组）：先全 False，出现的设 True，输出仍 False 的。

考试写法：Algorithm 1 outputs weight − total, the number of the missing item.

ex.q: Same data: what does algorithm 3's found array look like before output?
ex.a:
1. All of 51..59 set True.
  2. found[60] stays False.
  3. Output 60.
ex.az: 只有 60 仍 False。

ex.q: A student computes weight with range(A, A + 9). Result?
ex.a:
1. That sums 51..59 = 495 only (9 numbers).
  2. weight − total = 0 – wrong.
  3. A..A+9 is 10 numbers: range(A, A + 10).
ex.az:
1. 只加了 9 个数，结果 0。
  2. 应是 range(A, A+10)。

cards.t: Merits and demerits of the three algorithms
cards.en:
No algorithm wins on everything. Compare pairs:

PairWinnerReason
3 vs 23Shorter execution time: single loops (≈10+9+10) vs 90 comparisons
1 vs 31Less computer memory: two variables, no extra array
1 vs 21More efficient: fewer loop bodies, no nested loop

Special case: if more than one item is missing, algorithm 1 only gives the sum of the missing numbers – wrong. Algorithms 2 and 3 still list every missing item.

Exam wording: Algorithm 1 cannot find the missing items when more than one item is missing, because it only outputs the sum of their numbers.
cards.zh:
没有算法样样第一。

  • 3 vs 2：3 执行时间较短。
  • 1 vs 3：1 内存较少。
  • 1 vs 2：1 较有效率（无嵌套）。

特殊情况：缺多于一件时，算法 1 只得到号码之和，错误；算法 2、3 仍正确。

考试写法：Algorithm 1 cannot find the missing items when more than one item is missing, because it only outputs the sum of their numbers.

ex.q: A = 11, items 13 and 17 missing. Algorithm 1 output?
ex.a:
1. weight = 11 + … + 20 = 155.
  2. total = 155 − 30 = 125.
  3. Output 30 = 13 + 17: not an item number.
ex.az: 输出 30（两者之和），无用。

ex.q: Which algorithm would you choose for a tiny device with very little memory and exactly one missing item?
ex.a:
1. Memory is the limit → avoid the extra array.
  2. Only one missing → algorithm 1 is correct.
  3. Choose algorithm 1.
ex.az: 内存少且只缺一件 → 算法 1。

ex.q: A student answers "Algorithm 3 is best in all cases". Why is this incomplete?
ex.a:
1. It is fast and handles many missing items…
  2. …but uses an extra array (more memory than algorithm 1).
  3. State the trade-off and the situation.
ex.az:
1. 算法 3 用较多内存。
  2. 要说明取舍。

code.src:
A = 11
C = [11, 12, 14, 15, 16, 18, 19, 20]
weight = sum(range(A, A + 10))
total = sum(C)
print('Alg 1:', weight - total)
for i in range(A, A + 10):
    if i not in C:
        print('Alg 2/3:', i)
